name: IDRX
oneLiner: IDRX is PT IDRX Indo Inovasi's centralized rupiah stablecoin, backed 1:1 by IDR fiat reserves and Indonesian government bonds with KYC-gated mint and redeem.
collateral: Indonesian rupiah (IDR) fiat reserves and government bonds held 1:1 by PT IDRX Indo Inovasi; CertiK-audited smart contracts with multisig + timelock controls
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 mint and redemption of IDRX for Indonesian rupiah through IDRX platform after KYC verification; native multichain deployment with built-in bridge functions

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

reserves.name: IDR fiat reserves and government bonds

mintAuthority.summary: IDRX is issued by PT IDRX with centralized KYC-gated 1:1 mint/redeem against IDR fiat and government bonds; CertiK-audited contracts use multi-member approval and a 24-hour timelock to bound privileged admin actions.

controls.label: PT IDRX issuance backend
controls.evidence: PT IDRX operates centralized KYC-gated mint and redeem of IDRX against custodied IDR reserves and government bonds across its native-multichain deployment.

controls.label: IDRX multisig + 24h timelock admin
controls.evidence: IDRX security disclosures describe multi-member (multisig) approval for transactions and a 24-hour timelock on changes, bounding privileged admin/role operations; exact signer set and threshold not independently confirmed.

review.evidence: IDRX materials and CertiK-audit coverage describe a centralized fiat issuer with KYC-gated mint/redeem plus multi-member approval and a 24-hour timelock on privileged actions; minting is issuer-operated rather than permissionless.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Multisig/timelock controls reported in IDRX security disclosures; exact on-chain multisig signer/threshold and which operations the timelock governs were not independently confirmed in this pass.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the on-chain multisig signer set/threshold and whether the 24h timelock governs the mint path itself or only role/upgrade changes.
Resolve per-chain minter-admin and proxy admin across Polygon, Base, BSC, Klaytn, Gnosis, Etherlink, Worldchain, and Solana.
